name: P ZERO Race TLR SL-R

origin.basis: Italian tire maker; Pirelli says the P ZERO Race range is made at its plant in Italy near its Milan headquarters.

positioning: Pirelli's lightest slick tubeless race tire for road racing and time trials, with the LiteCORE casing.
pressure_note: The product page gives no maximum pressure; use the figure printed on the tire.

wet_notes.summary: Pirelli claims the SmartEVO2 compound gives grip and control in dry and wet conditions.

availability.note: Listed in Pirelli's UK catalogue with a dealer finder; sold by retail Tmall shops in mainland China (CNY 737 for 28C or 30C before discounts at one shop on 2026-11-01); North American availability not verified.

price_observations.market: 宝祥丰运动户外专营店 (Tmall retailer)
price_observations.conditions: Retail shop list price before discounts for the boxed 28C option; coupon price CNY 528. Not an official Pirelli store; single or pair not stated.

caveats: A race-day tire: only 28 and 30 mm, with a thin tread.
Hookless compatibility and maximum pressure are not stated.
